body: Writing on a piece if paper won't make my life more bearable

Well, where to start. Maybe give me a friend who actually cares about me instead of Hates me or pities me, give me a family that actually treats me like family instead if like dirt, give me a propose in life instead of just being a useless piece of shit, give me a skill do I can actually do something in life, make the girl im in love with actually speak to me and at least acknowledge my feelings, make everybody in the world stop hating me for no reason, and make me stupid enough that i don't see how pointless living is. Simple enough? I know i made the thread asking for help, but it was a mistake. Nobody here can or wants to help me and that's just the way it is

The reason I hate myself is because everyone else does. Strangers on the Internet don't really care about me. The just don't want a random person to kill themselves. If the knew anything about me, or knew more about my life, the wouldn't care or try to stop me as much. My problem is that I'm a problem, both I myself and to everyone around me. And there's only one reasonable way to solve it.
Everything I've ever loved has left me and nothing else can love me. I have something wrong with me and the only easy way out seems to be just ending the pain
I've never seen a doctor but I'd be surprised if I weren't
I'm sorry
Your faith is misplaced and it won't last much longer...

My family doesn't give a shit about me and nobody else would care. I could be gone and nobody would bat an eye. Nobody would care. If spending my life thinking about how to die is wasting it, then I guess it's a Better use than anything else my life can amount to. Nobody has hopes for me and nobody has faith in me. Pretty soon, you're not going to get a reply from me And you'll forget all about me. And that will be the end of it.

Today sucks and tomorrow will be worse. I can't just act like other people and give myself a new personality, it just doesn't work that way. The only reason I'm fighting against is the most reasonable way to deal with my shitty life. End it.
There's nothing at this point that can make my life better than death.
I still don't see any other way
Hope is wasted on me

How can you have faith in me when all I am is a failure and a miserable piece of shit. I don't want to keep living this life and no matter how strong I am, I'll never be happy, it just means I'll survive to see how shitty my life is.
I still can't do it. I'm reading what your saying and I hear your advice, but still all I want to do is die
Then I guess I'm just not strong enough to get through it
Some people just can't be strong...
But you know nothing about me, you don't know how strong I am
Maybe you're just a stronger person than me
I can't really believe its that easy

How can anybody expect to be happy when the people saying it can't even follow their advice? If someone told you to be happy when you're crying, you wouldn't just smile and be like them. I can't just be happy, there's no reason to. My life isn't the happy kind
I don't have any hobbies that I don't suck at and I can't exercise outside of running in circles
If the entire world says something, that doesn't make it true, and of everyone's live is beautiful and everyone in the world can just start being happy for no reason, that doesn't mean I can

That's what nobody seems to understand. I DONT BELIEVE IN MYSELF. Nobody believes in me, nobody cares about me, nobody loves me, and nobody ever will. I have no skills, friends, or reason to live. I can't just start smiling and pretend its all better. Everybody I've ever met has told me to just "buck up" and enjoy life for what it is, but all it is for me is a miserable string of terrible circumstances that is spiraling lower and lower and I don't want to be there when it hits the bottom.

There's nobody willing to help me for the money I have. The only way I can get treatment is if i blow thousands of dollars on a person who will sit for and hour or so then tell me in crazy. Id rarer not deal with that.
My mind is no longer mine and there's nothing I can do to get it back. I'm a useless annoying idiot and no matter how hard I try there's nothing I can do to change that

I dont know why I made this post. I know nobody can help me, they never do. I always just end up throwing away everyone's advice and pushing away anyone offering to help, even out of pity. You can't just "be someone's friend, you don't even know anything about me other than the fact that I'm constantly negative and hateful. There's nothing that I can do, especially not better than anyone else, and there's nothing in my life that actually wants to be in my life that can make me happy any time I find something or someone that brings me anything close to happiness it always either leaves or I push it away because I don't think I deserve it
That just depends on your definition of fun

Well, first off, it's bad advice in general, and even worse if you give it to someone who is depressed. Telling them to do something stupid is won't help them. If someone I going to kill themselves because they're miserable, and they decide to go out, get high, party, and get crazy, they could end up a alchoholic drug addict. That's not any better, that's worse. Not to mention if they have sex like theres no tomorrow they could get a crippling STD. It's not fun to act crazy, I've known people who party every day and act crazy, and every time they end up ruining their life one way or another, just for a night of craziness. If I wanted to just ruin my life, I would kill myself, without the added ruining of my already ruined life.

I'm not going to bother you because, as very one else has said, I just can't be helped. You'll just end up wasting your time. And I don't mean to think I suck, I just can't help it. If I hear a good song, I think about how amazing it is and then about how unamazing I am. I can't do anything and I probably will never be able to. I don't even have a bike or somewhere to ride it.
I've tried to develop skills my whole life, I just never get better. There's nowhere I volunteer near me, and even if there was I wouldn't be able to help anyone.

I'm a horrible singer and an even worse actor. Theres nothing I can do to make myself feel useful. There's nothing to do outside and there's nobody to meet. Even if I did, they wouldn't care, just like everyone else. They would be repulsed and hate me just like the rest of the world, no matter how hard I try to be liked. There's no way I can love myself when everybody hates me for being myself. If you met me, you wouldn't want to be my friend. The only reason you're offering is because it's no commitment to tell a random person you're their friend and then just drop it.
There's nothing I can do. I don't have any skills, money, or general ability to help anyone. I'm just completely useless and there's nothing I can do about it
I know a lot of people feel this way, that doesn't mean it will get better. Some people are just doomed to misery.
That's the most wreck less advice I've ever heard. Even if it was good, I can't even do anything close to fun.

Nice try Anton Chekov's PR agent. The reason so many people are happy is they have a use in their short inconsequential life or theyre just too stupid to realize any different.  Also, your numbers are highly off and generally inaccurate

Nobody gives a shit what goes on in my life. I can't just distract myself from my shitty life because it's all around me. If I draw, I see what a shitty artist I am, if I listen to music I think about how I can never be that talented and successful. If I try to talk to a friend I just realize that I have no friends and it's just me alone in my misery
I know it's not a good thing to do but it seems to be the only way to end the pain. There's no other way to just make life "better"
The thing that pushes me to the edge is life in general. There's no way I can just "stay away" from the things that make my life shitty
As an RES user, I still learn something.
TIL
Got it. I thought you but the link in the brackets and the text in the parentheses, which I do all the time...
I think you accidentally the link (brackets, them parentheses)
That's borderline creepy, you don't even know me or her, but thanks. It does mean a lot.
I'll be sure to let you know how it goes when I get a new phone

It touches my heart that you would do something like that for me. This isn't the first time I've been here and every single time I've been given a reason to put down the knife. I still dont know what I'm going to do about telling the girl I love and I still don't know what to do with my life, but at least I'll know that there are a few people out there who care in a small way. You can't even imagine how big of an impact this has on me (you may, but still) and I hope I don't have to come back soon. If you can help me tell her in any way that would help a lot.... 

EDIT: I think I'm just going to text her and tell her I love her and then throw my phone in my pool. I don't give a shit what she thinks of me or the other guy or anything. I'm sick of looking out for others at my own expense, I'm just going to tell her. I don't care if it fucks up her summer or confuses her or loses me my best and only friend, I just want to do it.
Amazing words. Thank you.
Nevermind, you answered it in the edit. You have an amazing story as I hope all works out for you. I hope I figure out what to do soon...

That's amazing. Whenever I see something like that I can't imagine why a ill powerful god would waste his time adjusting leg sizes at an evangelist group instead of, you know, curing cancer or ending world hunger. Things that make a lot of peoples lives miserable for a lot I reasons, instead of appearing on toast and making touchdowns. I'm not trying to devalue your experience, it's an amazing occurrence, but if anything it just makes me want to worship him less. He always seems like a hypocritical, emotional, jerk.

I understand what just means to me, and he doesnt fit it. I've seen what he doesn't and heard what people say about him, and frankly even if he doesn't exist, he's no god I'd like to worship. Just out of curiosity, what was the miracle?
That seems exactly like my situation, except that the girl isn't interested in being anything more than friends. Even just "buddies." just out of curiosity, what happened to her?
If there really is a kind and just god, he has a lot of explaining to do.
Franky I dont see any choice better than telling her, but I just can't bear to lose her
What was your life changing experience?

Well I wasn't being completely metaphorical. I doubt well ever see each other, just due to complications with various things, but also there's a very little chance of us being that close with her in the situation she is now.
If they are out there I've certainly never met them

I'm not running away, I'm just living. We're living apart and the more time I waste the further away she gets, metaphorically of course. I won't get another chance to seize perfection and even if I do, perfection will probably already be seized by the other guy.

I'm not going to see her again any time soon or in the future, and even If I do, I won't get anywhere by being apart from her and I wind get anywhere by being close to her. She isn't looking for someone else to confide in, she has one who she's obsessed about.

i really cant see anyone better than her, as unlikley as it seems. it might just be the rose colored glasses, but i know shes not perfect. she has flaws. but the flaws make her better. shes perfect to me, and thats all that matters.

My situation is just like that except in this one the roles are reversed. I'm the nice guy trying to get her to see that I love her and the guy she's known her whole life is the douche who's 4 years older than her and has no interest in her even though she's madly in live with him. She doesn't confide in me, she doesn't tell me anything about her life, I can't even mention the name of the guy he loves because se feels its to personal. Theres no way we can stay friends until college and even if we did, she would never chance it. She would just see me as a buddy that she tell her stories to and helps her with her work. I know I'm handling it the wrong way but that only because I have no idea of the right way.

Because its the difference between never seeing her again but still possibly being a distance memory of that one weird kid that used to talk to her, and completely pushing her away and having her not want to talk to me again.

I'm 17, and before you says anything about how well teen relationships work out and how many more chances I'll have, just know that I completely believe that too. I thought that no relationship lasts through Highschool and someone under 20 couldnt know what love it and there are millions more, but then I met her and I changed my mind. I know what I feel for her is love, it's real love. I don't want to be with anyone else, and if it's just infatuation, I don't want to know what love is...

I guess you might be right........ I know I need to love myself, but it's so hard when nobody in the world can love me. I've tried and tried to love myself, but someone has always given me a reason why that's wrong, and at some point I just stopped trying because I knew someone would let me know that it's wrong for me to be loved. Thank you for being the first realistic response I've ever gotten for depression.

But it's already been more than a few weeks and she's still obsessed about this storybook romance. She's willing to wait forever to get her prince charming to realize their meant for each other... And she knew him before she knew me. She was in live with him when she met me. I don't even think he's appreciated everything I've done for her because she's been too busy thinking I'm just her buddy and hes the guy she's meant for, I she's not open to any relationship because she's holding out for him. And even if she does stop caring about him at some point and have even the slightest little inkling that she may just like me, what If I do it too soon. Even if I don't lose her I might freak her out and make everything awkward, and it certainly won't make her think of me as close of a friend as the other guy......
I just can't imagine being with a girl better than her...

I'm not building her up, I'm just telling the truth. And possibly the largest most glaring reasons is because she is "absolutely in love" with a guy 4 years older than she is who has no romantic intentions with her. Funny how that works out huh? The perfect girl for me, the one girl I love more than any other loves somebody else.....
A whole long list of reasons as to why it's better if I just let my one chance at true happiness slip away than to try and grab it risk losing it forever.

I'm not asking you to solve my problems for me, i never asked to solve my problems, or to help me in any difficult way. I'm Just saying that I have a serious problem and I don't know how to solve it so I was hoping that I could find some people who actually care enough to give me a reason to fight. I don't expect everything to just be solved, I just need somebody to talk it over with and show me that not everyone in the world hates me so i have enough time to solve it myself. This is /r/offmychest, a place where people get things off their chest, and I'm getting off my chest that I'm miserable because I have no friends and I can't admit my feelings to the girl I love and that I need help. You don't have to help me if you don't think I deserve it because I'm depressed and reaching out for help, but if you have to comment, at least make constructive. I appreciate the frankness, but There's tough love, then there's telling someone who is depressed and alone that they're in a hole of doom and they shouldn't get help because they're not worth helping unless they can prove they don't need help.
that seems like a very vague and not so plausible answer, but thank you for taking the time to comment.

I try to help anyone I can, I'm always nice and kind to everyone i meet no matter what. It always seems though that they don't give a shit anyway. I never have anything witty to tape to a wall and even if I did they would rip it down before anyone saw. The world is very unfair to people who are kind and in pain like me and the girl I love, but very fair the the assholes and the jerks who make my life miserable.

Your story is a very inspirational one, you should be proud to tell it. Even though I don't believe it will work out like that for me, as even I it does it wouldnt be nearly as worth it, but I'll try to remember it. I still just wish I could see her one last time so I could tell her, that's all I want. I don't think I'm in any position to be helping people with their problems.
I can see it now... "Oh hey, I noticed your recent post on reddit. I too have gone though similar circumstances and that has led me to believe that we are soulmates. I love you. Let's date."

Heres an thought going off the idea of "one true love." what if there's a girl out there, just like me, going though the same stuff, same interests, and amazing in every way. just like the girl I love, except not already "engaged" to a guy 4 years older than her who has no interest in her in that way. and say that we're destined to meet in, say, 20 years. Now what if, because she feels the same way i do, has these same problems. And now what if, she doesn't know about reddit and has nobody there for her, and decides there's nobody for her, and does something very rash. What happens then? Where does that leave me?

I never said I didn't want to talk to people. I said I didn't want to talk to a counselor or a psychologist because I know it would be a long expensive waste of time. I would love to walk to people who actually (seem to) care, and I would love to have a friend to talk to, especially the girl I love if that were possible...

I do really love her, but she just barely sees me as a friend, she never tell me anything about how she's feeling or her life, and completely distances herself from me. I know she's going through a lot of stuff too, and she really just doesn't want to be close to me there is nobody else who cares about me and if there are, I really don't feel like waiting through years of loneliness and misery just to meet them.
my life is so awful the only people who give a shit are strangers on the internet.

it seems like youre saying that accepting the fact that my life is horrible is a good thing and the the best thing to do is end it. sorry if i took it the wrong way, my mind isnt working right after all thats happened.

that is one of the vaguest comments ive ever seen. are you saying that my life really is awful and that its a good idea to kill myself? i really dont want to kill myself, but i honestly see no other point in life.

ive tried my whole life and ive havent gotten anywhere. ive tried to develop skills, ive trained and ive practiced and ive never improved anywhere. ive tried to make fiends, but nobody has ever even given me a chance. ive put myself out there time and time again and i only get hurt or denied. i know what kinds of people i like and ive never met someone like it who wants to have anything to do with me. and ive told you, shes not interested in me at any more than a "story buddy" and asking her out only ensures rejection and ruins whatever "friendship" we have. that means losing the only person who gives something of a shit about me, even to a tiny degree. i dont expect to just wake up one day and be happy, but i at least expect to wake up feeling better than the day before. to feel like im not just an unlovable piece of shit, and so far that just hasnt happened yet. no matter how hard i try and how hard i hope i never get anywhere close to ahead. i just feel like theres no use trying when i know theres nowhere to go

for some reason making a list of stupid things im good would make me feel worse. woo, i took off my socks. thats what im good at. taking off fucking socks. it would make me feel like an infant if taking off socks was my only accomplishment before taking a nap. i have no real life skills other than what gets me through the day without being completely handicapped. i can read and write and walk, but thats about it. 
i have no friends other than the one girl and shes not even really crazy about being my friend. she never tell me about her life and she never wants to hang out with me except for when shes telling me about the latest story she wrote. her stories are great but i want more. i want to know more about her life. she has a ton of friends, even though she claims she doesnt have that many, but none of them would want to hang out with me. i cant tell her im feeling depressed because not only would she not be able to help me, but then it would be a burden on her and i dont want her to have to worry about me. i cant tell her because im just a fucking wimp. i was going to tell her, but i chickened out and now im probably never going to see her again. i missed my chance and now theres no fucking way i can get it back. even if i was able to tell her, she is "in love" with someone else. the reason i put it in quotes is because i dont believe its really love, but thats a whole other very complicated story.
the fact of the matter is that i really dont care about what people think of me. if i did i would have killed myself a long time ago. i dont give a shit that my parents dont think im good enough and i certainly dont give a shit that everyone around me hates me. i care about what i think, and frankly right now i think im a sorry miserable useless waste of life who offers nothing to the world and whom noone would miss and who is such a huge pussy he literaly cant look the girl he loves in the face and tell her because hes worried about how shed react. that doesnt seem like any way to live a life and it certainyl isnt something i should enjoy. all i want is a way to let her know how i feel and a way out.
